title: SQL Fundamentals Quiz
description: Test your understanding of SQL queries

questions.title: Books with High Prices
questions.description: In the books table, find the title, price, and publication_year for all books with a price greater than 50.
options: SELECT title, price, publication_year FROM books WHERE price > 50;
SELECT title, price, publication_year FROM books WHERE price >= 50;
SELECT title, publication_year, price FROM books WHERE price > 50;
questions.explanation: This query selects specific columns (title, price, publication_year) from the books table where the price is greater than 50.

questions.title: Book Orders Information
questions.description: Using the books and book_orders tables, find the title, order_date, and quantity for each book order.
options: SELECT b.title, bo.order_date, bo.quantity FROM book_orders AS bo JOIN books AS b ON bo.book_id = b.id;
SELECT books.title, book_orders.order_date, book_orders.quantity FROM books JOIN book_orders ON books.id = book_orders.book_id;
SELECT title, order_date, quantity FROM books, book_orders WHERE books.id = book_orders.book_id;
SELECT b.title, bo.order_date, bo.quantity FROM books b, book_orders bo WHERE b.id = bo.book_id;
questions.explanation: This query joins the books and book_orders tables using aliases to find the title from books along with the order_date and quantity from book_orders.

questions.title: Expensive Book Orders
questions.description: Using the books and book_orders tables, find the title, order_date, and quantity for all book orders where the book price is greater than 40.
options: SELECT b.title, bo.order_date, bo.quantity FROM book_orders bo JOIN books b ON bo.book_id = b.id WHERE b.price > 40;
SELECT books.title, book_orders.order_date, book_orders.quantity FROM books JOIN book_orders ON books.id = book_orders.book_id WHERE books.price > 40;
SELECT title, order_date, quantity FROM books, book_orders WHERE books.id = book_orders.book_id AND price > 40;
SELECT b.title, bo.order_date, bo.quantity FROM books b INNER JOIN book_orders bo ON b.id = bo.book_id AND b.price > 40;
questions.explanation: This query joins the books and book_orders tables and adds a WHERE clause to filter for books with a price greater than 40.

questions.title: Orders by Genre
questions.description: Find the genre and the total number of books ordered for each genre, ordered by the total number of books (descending).

segments.value: FROM books b JOIN book_orders bo ON b.id = bo.book_id

questions.explanation: This query uses GROUP BY to aggregate book orders by genre and calculates the sum of quantities ordered for each genre.

questions.title: Simple Selection
questions.description: Write a query to retrieve all customers from the USA.
options: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE country = 'United States';
SELECT * FROM customers WHERE country LIKE '%USA%';
SELECT * FROM customers WHERE state IN ('NY', 'CA', 'IL');
questions.explanation: To select all customers from a specific country, we use the WHERE clause with the exact country name.

questions.title: Sorting Results
questions.description: Order products by price from highest to lowest.
questions.explanation: To sort results in descending order, we use ORDER BY followed by the column name and the DESC keyword.

questions.title: Counting Results
questions.description: Count how many customers are from each country.
questions.explanation: To count items by group, we use the COUNT() aggregate function with GROUP BY clause.

questions.title: Basic JOIN
